text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *wheeze*... Dammit...! 
Dammiiiit! Aaaaaaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: So this is Festa's... Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: A-A-Awe... some...!
choice_data_list: I was totally captivated.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Very, very much!! I'm so glad I snuck 
out of the hospital!!
choice_data_list: Did you sneak out of the hospital!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I made sure to get my 
physician's approval before coming all the 
way here.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, about your illness...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hearing about me isn't very interesting, 
you know. More importantly!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I'll check with my father once more. To 
see if he has any footage of the Festa 
left that could serve as a reference, 
anything at all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just a sliver of extra 
information, I want to be of help to you 
all.
choice_data_list: Huh, are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Huh, of course! So Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Please, make the absolute most of her 
life... to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, my debut race is over. Trainer, what 
are your thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Shall we start making concrete plans for 
our challenge at the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe?"
choice_data_list: (The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Among all the world's GⅠ races, this is 
the absolute pinnacle. The very peak where 
every Umamusume and person involved dreams 
of claiming 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because of that, lively debates have 
taken place across various countries. One 
argument among them posits that 
Classic-class Umamusume hold the 
advantage."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether to challenge it in the Senior 
Class with mature technique, or in the 
Classic Class while riding high on 
momentum. That is a vital question, and—
choice_data_list:
Including the prep period, I want to 
carefully consider when we should make our 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh? Getting cold feet?
choice_data_list: Of course not.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What fills my chest right now is 
anticipation. The feelings I had watching 
her debut race were...
choice_data_list:
I need information to help you win on the 
world stage.

I need information to help you win on the 
world stage.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah... I see. I just made my debut, and 
you're a rookie.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Then that makes sense. Right now, we 
ain't got any data that could serve as a 
weapon. Let's take our time with this."
choice_data_list: So you're not opposed, huh.
So you're not opposed, then.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Obviously, right? Going in blind just to 
lose— who the hell would do something that 
boring?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A gamble's only fun because of the 
all-or-nothing stakes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whether that one chance exists or not— 
that's what the data tells you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, no particular goal for now. I'll 
just run races casually until the Classic 
Year and focus on gathering information.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
By the way, how long do you plan to wait 
and see?
choice_data_list: How about until next year's Keisei Hai?
How about until next year's Keisei Hai?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A GIII held in the first half of January 
of the Classic Year. It's a 2000m turf 
race, held at Nakayama Racecourse with its 
steep final slope.
choice_data_list:
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe has steep 
hills too, after all...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, so you're saying it's not a bad 
place to use as a point of reference. I 
like it—that greed of yours.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Then until then, allow me to purely enjoy 
myself. In this thing called the Twinkle 
Series—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *wheeze*... Dammit...! 
Dammiiiit! Aaaaaaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—A world where every single rival aims for 
greater heights and pours their absolute 
all into the fight... That is what this 
realm is.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Even without the media breathing down my 
neck, it feels like there's never a dull 
moment in the Twinkle Series.
choice_data_list:
You've got quite a happy look on your 
face.
You've got such a happy look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Well, it certainly makes you 
feel alive.
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, your teacher said so 
too.

Come to think of it, your teacher said 
that too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I relay the words entrusted to me by her 
teacher—"Please make good use of it."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh... I see. ...Sensei did.
choice_data_list: Did your eyes look that dead back then?
Did your eyes look that dead back then?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Idiot.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Rather than thinking about such nonsense, 
shouldn't you be gathering data first?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Go on, shoo, shoo. I still need to get 
changed, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I get kicked out of the waiting room by 
Nakayama Festa. ...Since I have to wait 
for her anyway, maybe I should use this 
time to gather data.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pondered as I pulled out my smartphone. 
The immediate goal is—the Keisei Hai next 
January!
